implementedFoundation: single-attempt Action execution consumes only an active tenant-scoped ExecutionLease and never automatically retries a timeout
initial and reconcile Action Receipts are append-only and protected from update, delete and truncate by PostgreSQL triggers
Action lineage can deterministically project ActionEvent and ActionReceipt rows with unknown and reconcile semantics
AIP-4 UsageReceipt distinguishes measured, estimated and unknown, enforces cost currency and supports append-only adjustments
the strict web clients reject mismatched Proposal, Lease, Receipt and lineage resources

findings.finding: execute commits the Lease as consumed and Proposal as executing before calling the provider, but creates no durable dispatch attempt or outbox row first; a process crash can leave a consumed Lease with no ActionReceipt and no authoritative recovery instruction.
ActionReceipt does not bind actionBindingHash, Preview, CapabilityBinding, AccountBinding, AdapterRevision, ApprovalSet, BudgetReservation or the exact DryValidationReceipt used for execution.

AdapterOutcome payload is accepted as an untyped object and copied into the Receipt without an Adapter output schema, marking, secret or PII filter, canonical provider-response hash or evidence extraction contract.

the Action executor never invokes AipTelemetryUsageService or the provider usage bridge; ActionReceipt and UsageReceipt remain separate authorities with no exact action, lease, adapter or provider-request join.
no measured or unknown UsageReceipt settles or releases the W5-03 budget reservation; count-based aip_action_usage cannot prove currency, actual cost, quota consumption or refund.
Action execution does not append canonical lineage in the same delivery path; a separate trusted reconcile endpoint must be called before the lineage list contains current Action facts.
Action lineage hashes selected Receipt columns but its source query omits the immutable Receipt payload, so the lineage artifact hash does not cover the complete provider result body.
initial Action Receipts always write an empty evidenceRefs array and the AdapterOutcome protocol has no governed Artifact or Evidence output references.

an accepted provider outcome keeps the Proposal executing, while the current reconcile endpoint accepts only unknown initial Receipts; no canonical callback or polling transition closes accepted to applied or failed.
